Let's ''ride''.''"<br />"''Gnrrooff.|Tott Doneeta and a boma|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Bomas''' were ravenous beasts native to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and its moon [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref name="kotor2" /> Although most bomas were generally small, there were some that were extremely large in size, as experienced by the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] and her companions while exploring the moon. They were dangerous predators and known to kill [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], but they themselves were preyed upon by the [[Zakkeg/Legends|zakkeg]] beasts.<ref name="kotor2" /> Furthermore, they were, like most beasts of Dxun and Onderon, preyed upon by [[Drexl]].
{{Creature-stub}}

==Description==
{{Quote|I would rather ride in a Jawa sandcrawler than on the back of this awful creature!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="EE">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>}}
A species of monstrous, wingless beasts that had green reptilian hides, long tails, four horns, dagger-like claws, and savage teeth.<ref name="CE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Gnroo nrarrggaa!''"<br />"''Waroooon!|Tott Doneeta and a boma charge into Oron Kira's citadel|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi 2" />}}
[[File:BomaEmpireEnd.jpg|left|thumb|240px|The boma on Onderon during [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]]]
They thrived on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] and in the forests of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="CE" />

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tott Doneeta]] used his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] ability to [[Animal bond|communicate with animals]] to use some bomas in order to get into [[Oron Kira]]'s citadel.

During the [[Telosian Restoration Project|restoration]] of [[Telos IV]], several bomas were intended to be brought to the surface of Telos to help balance out the ecosystem. They may have been intended to control the populations of [[cannok]]s.

At the time of the [[Galactic War]], there was still one [[Mandalorian clan]] existing that has bred the vicious bomas for centuries in their breeding pens.<ref name="Breeding">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Boma Breeding}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Boma.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A boma in the Dxun jungle.]]
Bomas were first introduced in [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (miniseries)|''Knights of the Old Republic'']] sub-series of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]].

In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', [[Meetra Surik]] learned a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] called beast control by taming a large boma in the jungles of Dxun moon.

In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', bomas appear as player mounts from a Cartel Market pack.
